description: This file defines the ErrorValue class, which provides static methods to identify and evaluate error values within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including functions for checking error states like IS_ERR, IS_ERROR, and IS_NA.

classes.name: ErrorValue
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to determine if a value corresponds to specific spreadsheet error states.

methods.name: isErr
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is an error and not NaN; supports array input.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Determines if the value is recognized as an error code; supports array input.

methods.name: isNa
methods.description: Checks if the value is the #N/A error; supports array input.
